clips.title: The story
paras: Drulzegar Skraghook, a fisherman at Shadowprey Village in Desolace, lost the entire crew to the naga while fishing near Ranazjar Isle. Guilt weighs on Drulzegar, who asks you to go after the Slitherblade.

Drulzegar Skraghook and the crew fished by Ranazjar Isle, which lies north of a wreck on the coast, and had done so many times. One morning the naga attacked and killed everyone except Drulzegar. Since then revenge is all Drulzegar thinks about, and the guilt is too much to bear.

Drulzegar wants seven Slitherblade Myrmidons, seven Slitherblade Naga and five Slitherblade Sorceresses slain. A bad knee keeps Drulzegar from going along. The naga, Drulzegar says, usually lurk far down among the coral reefs beneath the waves, and the effort will be rewarded.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... My crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades.
The naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me.
Me conscience can't handle the guilt, adventurer; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?

clips.title: Progress
paras: I still hear their voices crying for help when the naga unleashed their chaos over us. If I didn't have this bad knee, I'd go and help you kill those blasted naga!
You can usually guarantee to find them deep in the coral reefs below the surface... Lurking... Scheming...

clips.title: Completion
paras: As sweet as it is hearing the news that the naga have been vanquished, my heart still feels empty. For the rest of my life I will be dedicated to having them all killed.
Here mon, your reward as I promised. It's small in comparison to the gratification of knowing the naga fried for their hated act upon my crew.
